subject: Request: invoice remittance across multiple Novamed legal entities
messages:
From: Lila Grant <lila.grant@novamed.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@novamed.com
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:12:00 +0100
Subject: Request: invoice remittance across multiple Novamed legal entities

Hi Chloe,

We're onboarding Redwood for a short POC (PO 9931 attached) and need guidance on how to receive a single monthly billing bundle that we can split across three legal entities for payment and VAT reporting.

High-level:
- Entities: Novamed UK Ltd (GB VAT GB123456), Novamed GmbH (DE VAT DE987654), Novamed US Inc (EIN 12-3456789)
- Desired deliverable: one consolidated PDF (cover + invoice detail) and a machine-readable remittance CSV with line-level allocation and a cost-center column
- VAT: several lines are invoiced in EUR and need to be split between DE and UK entities; we need VAT per-entity and net amounts
- Ask: can Redwood produce per-line allocation and separate VAT calculations, and what exact fields do you need from us?

Attached: Novamed_PO_9931.pdf

Thanks,
Lila Grant
Head of Finance Operations
Novamed Health
lila.grant@novamed.com
+44 20 5555 1212

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Lila Grant <lila.grant@novamed.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 14:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: invoice remittance across multiple Novamed legal entities

Hi Lila — great to meet you via email. We can support the workflow you're describing. Short answers: 

- Yes: Redwood can emit a single consolidated PDF with a cover page plus separate invoice pages for each legal entity, and we can also provide a machine-readable remittance CSV with per-line entity_code and cost_center columns.
- VAT treatment: we can calculate VAT per entity provided you confirm which invoice lines should be allocated to which legal entity and supply VAT numbers for each.
- Delivery: we can deliver the files via SFTP, secure download link, or add to a shared Drive folder; DocuSign/Drive links for records are supported.

Please fill the attached allocation_template.csv (columns: invoice_line_id, entity_code, percentage_split, cost_center, vat_number) and return it. Once we have that we can generate a pro-forma set and confirm invoice numbers and remit instructions.

I've looped in Ben from Finance to advise on numbering and the VAT note language.

Attachments: allocation_template.csv (CSV template)

Cheers,
Chloe Martin
Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com
(415) 555-0199

Ben — forwarding Novamed's request. Key asks:

- Need guidance: separate invoice numbers per legal entity vs single invoice with allocation lines. I think for VAT reporting we should issue multiple invoice numbers but keep one consolidated remittance id. Thoughts?

> [original message below]

Chloe

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Novamed PO 9931 — allocation template and VAT question

Short version: issue separate invoice numbers per legal entity. Reasons:
- VAT/legal: Each legal entity must have its own invoice for domestic VAT reporting in DE/UK.
- Audit trail: easier for AP to match payments to invoices and for our accounting team to post VAT outputs.

Implementation notes:
- Create consolidated "remittance bundle id" that links the three invoice numbers. Include that bundle id on the single PDF cover page and in the CSV.
- Ensure each invoice shows entity address and VAT reg number. Line-level net and VAT should be shown for each entity-only lines.
- For the US entity (non-VAT), show 0% VAT and include the EIN.

I'll prepare a short template for invoice numbering (RNW-YYMM-<entity>) and an example cover PDF. I can draft the billing note language for the cover page.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Hi Lila,

Thanks for the details. Per Ben's guidance, Redwood will: 
- Issue three invoice numbers (one per legal entity) linked by a single remittance bundle id (bundle RNW-2606-9931).
- Provide a consolidated PDF (cover page + the three invoices) and a CSV remittance file with columns: invoice_number, invoice_line_id, entity_code, cost_center, allocated_amount, vat_amount, vat_number.
- Use the allocation_template.csv you return to drive per-line splits. Please confirm the completed template by end of day tomorrow and let us know whether you prefer SFTP or a secure link for delivery.

Next steps:
1) You: return allocation_template.csv with entity_code values (UK/DE/US) and cost_center mapping.
2) We: generate pro-forma invoices and send for your POC approval.

Attachments: proforma_sample_cover.pdf (sample cover page)

If you'd like, we can also include a billing note in the CSV mapping to your internal PO (e.g., NOV-PO-9931).
